voice.summary: Michael Smith writes in the hushed, confident register of a gallery catalogue. Names, years and one precise adjective carry the introduction, with serif italics for emphasis.
dos: Introduce work with collection name and year
Use one precise adjective per sentence
Keep calls to action to two words
donts: Never write more than two lines of bio

taglines: Work that waits to be seen
boilerplate: Michael Smith is an independent creative whose Collection '26 gathers recent photography and design in a dark, editorial portfolio.
